---
title: "Pipelines"
---

Acht zelfsturende AI-pipelines, elk met een eigen repo (privé, Research-Ready org):

1. Citable reproducible research (uc1-research)
2. App + serious games builder (uc2-app-builder)
3. Chatbot with voice (uc3-chatbot-voice)
4. Supply chain visualization (uc4-supply-chain)
5. Business creation pipeline (uc5-business-creation)
6. Specialized model creation (uc6-model-creation)
7. Careermaker (uc7-careermaker)
8. Survey report (uc8-survey-report)
